# zjm-rag

> zjm-rag is RAG over local folders. zg (zvec-grep) finds candidate files, Jev (the OpenRouter Decisions API) judges which of them contain the answer, and an LLM answers from those files only, citing their paths.

zjm-rag keeps a named index, a **locker**, for each project. `file_add` copies files or folders into a locker and indexes the copy, so the originals stay where they are. `find` asks zg for up to 40 hits, keeps the first 8 different files in zg's order (`--limit` changes the 8), and returns them split at a threshold (0.5 by default) into accepted and rejected. With sending on (`send` for a project, `egress.rank` for direct use), Jev scores each file from its path and up to 12,000 characters of its matched text. `ask` (which needs `send` for a project, `egress.answer` for direct use) sends the accepted files to an OpenRouter model (`deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash` by default) and returns the answer with the paths it used; small files go whole, the rest as matched parts, within 200,000 characters. When no file passes, no model is called. Lockers are encrypted with an age key the app supplies, or plain. zjm never stores a key.

It runs only in its Docker container. Nothing leaves the machine unless a sending switch allows it. In a project set up with the skill, that switch is `send` in `zjm-project.json`, which turns on ranking and answering. Direct use (the `zjm` CLI, the library, the HTTP API and the MCP server) follows the config's `egress` setting, `{"rank": ..., "answer": ...}`, off by default: ranking and answering use OpenRouter (`OPENROUTER_API_KEY`). Translating the question needs `egress.translate`, and a project never sends it.

Interfaces, all inside the container:
- The `zjm_rag` Python package (standard library only): lockers, files, `find`, `ask`, `doctor`, `help`.
- The `zjm` command: the same operations from a shell, plus `zjm doctor` and `zjm help`. `--json` prints the result as one JSON object.
- `zjm serve`: a local JSON API on 127.0.0.1:8765, with `GET /health` and `POST /<operation>` (for example `/find`). It needs an `egress` switch on in the config.
- `zjm mcp`: an MCP server over stdio, one tool per operation (`zjm_file_add`, `zjm_find`, `zjm_ask`, `zjm_help`, and so on). Agents call `zjm_help` first. Add it to Claude Code with `claude mcp add zjm -- zjm mcp`.

Install with one line: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cocodedk/zjm-rag/main/install.sh | sh`. It needs Docker and python3 (3.10+). The installer builds the `zjm-rag:latest` image, puts the `zjm` command in `~/.local/bin`, creates a config with all outside calls off if none exists, and installs the Claude Code skill `zjm-rag` into `~/.claude/skills/zjm-rag` (or `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`). Then run `zjm doctor` to check the install.

Set up a project by creating `zjm-project.json` at its top folder (the git top level, or the working folder without git), with `locker`, `folders`, `exclude`, `send`, `llm` and `multilingual`. Keep `send` at `false` until you want answers. `send` is the skill's switch only; direct use follows `egress`. Add `.zvec-grep/` to `.gitignore`. Then run `~/.claude/skills/zjm-rag/scripts/zjm-project reindex` after every change to an indexed folder, and `find` or `ask` to search. If a search prints `STALE:`, reindex first. `ask` is refused unless `send` is true.

## WebMCP tools

This site has WebMCP tools. Both pages, [/](https://rag.cocode.dk/) and [/fa/](https://rag.cocode.dk/fa/), declare them through `document.modelContext.registerTool` (module: `/webmcp.js`). All three are read-only, take no input, read the page at call time, answer in the page language and make no requests.

- `describe`: Returns what this zjm-rag page is about, its language, its sections and the other tools, in the page language.
- `get_install_command`: Returns the one-line command that installs zjm-rag, whether it is available, and its requirements; it runs nothing.
- `list_interfaces`: Lists the four ways to call zjm-rag (Python package, CLI, HTTP JSON API, MCP server), each with whether it is available, a summary, its spec link and an example if there is one.
